items.title: fix(memory): emit JSON for selected-provider status refusals (#183373)
items.summary: fix(memory): emit JSON for selected-provider status refusals (#183373) fix(memory): print a JSON error from memory status --deep --json when another plugin owns the memory slot When a plugin other than Memory Core owned the memory slot, `openclaw memory status --deep --json` exited 1 with nothing on stdout, which broke scripts reading the documented JSON error. It now prints one standard cli_error JSON document naming the owning plugin, and still exits 1. Evidence: built CLI with the real memory-lancedb plugin installed through the shipped `openclaw plugins install memory-lancedb`. On main the deep JSON status printed nothing on stdout (twice); with this change it prints a cli_error document and exits 1 (twice). Plain `memory status --json` works on both. Thanks @Leon-SK668. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
